svg.title: The complete passenger journey
svg.desc: Cocoon Cabin English portfolio, translated from the user-revised nine-page case study. Embedded 3840 x 2160 background with native editable text on a 2560 x 1440 canvas.

text.tspan: EXPERIENCE / A FIRST-TIME RIDER WITH LUGGAGE
Gesture to request a ride. The taxi recognises the request and stops; board, then collect your luggage and leave at arrival.
Open when ready. Move the seat
One experience concept: hand-shape recognition on the web; the complete journey implemented independently in Unity / Quest.
